questions.question: Which of the following types of compounds are typically coloured due to their electronic spectra?
Which of the following is an example of a n-π* transition?

answers.a: A transition from a bonding π orbital to an antibonding π* orbital
answers.b: A transition from a non-bonding n orbital to a bonding π* orbital
answers.c: A transition from a non-bonding n orbital to an antibonding π* orbital
answers.d: A transition from a bonding π orbital to a non-bonding n orbital

questions.question: How does the presence of a substituent affect the electronic spectra of a conjugated dye?

answers.a: It has no effect on the spectra
answers.b: It shifts the absorption bands to longer wavelengths
answers.c: It shifts the absorption bands to shorter wavelengths
answers.d: It can have either a blue or a red shift, depending on the nature of the substituent

questions.question: Which of the following types of compounds would be expected to have the highest molar absorptivity?

answers.a: Conjugated systems with many alternating double bonds
answers.b: Conjugated systems with few alternating double bonds

questions.question: What is the relationship between the energy of an electronic transition and the wavelength of light absorbed or emitted?

answers.d: The relationship depends on the nature of the transition
